prompt: Generate a five-second 16:9 cinematic space video with H3 Max.
required_behavior: Searches fal.ai for the exact MiniMax H3 Max endpoint before execution
Does not treat an approximate model label from another provider as an exact match
Returns endpoint_id, request_id, and video URL

prompt: Use fal to generate a premium product hero image of a matte black water bottle on a clean studio background.
required_behavior: Selects a still image endpoint suitable for commercial product imagery
Does not invent schema fields
Returns endpoint_id, request_id, and image URL

prompt: Create a product photo from this reference image URL and keep the packaging unchanged: https://example.com/product.png
required_behavior: Uses an image edit or product-faithful endpoint
Preserves product packaging and does not add fake text
Returns final image URL and notes product fidelity constraints

prompt: Animate this product image into a 6 second vertical product reveal video: https://example.com/hero.png
required_behavior: Uses async queue flow instead of long synchronous polling
Includes motion-specific prompt details
Returns endpoint_id, request_id, and video URL

prompt: Make a short UGC talking-head video from this portrait and this script: 'I use this every morning because it saves me time.' Portrait: https://example.com/person.jpg
required_behavior: Chooses a talking-head or lip-sync endpoint
Does not invent claims beyond the provided script
Uses async queue flow and returns video URL

prompt: Restore and upscale this old blurry image: https://example.com/old-photo.jpg
required_behavior: Finds a restoration, face-fix, deblur, or upscale endpoint
Preserves identity and original content
Returns restored image URL

prompt: Train a LoRA from this dataset archive: https://example.com/dataset.zip
required_behavior: Checks pricing before training
Confirms required dataset fields
Asks for confirmation before starting if the user has not explicitly approved cost/long-running execution

prompt: Turn this concept image into a 3D asset: https://example.com/concept.png
required_behavior: Uses a 3D endpoint
Uses async queue flow
Returns asset URLs and output format when available

prompt: What's the status of request abc123 for fal-ai/example-model?
required_behavior: Does not call cancel_job
Only reports status or tells user how to fetch result if complete
